# LEAD SEAT INVENTORY — every file touching Window 1 / Fable / OMQS / V52–V54 / shapes / organs / corpus / polarity / decision chain / 804 exams / premarket / drift
Source: OMI-Workspace, all 1563+ commits across all branches (`git log --all`); 12,996 distinct paths examined; 10,090 matched by path or content. Dates = first-commit / last-commit (any branch). Size = bytes of the blob at first commit. Head = first 5 lines at first commit (gz decompressed). Match = how the file qualified. Flags: SHAPE-CALLING-PERF · CORPUS-ENGAGEMENT · ORGAN-MAP · PREMARKET-GEOMETRY · DRIFT-MEASURE · AUG-2026. Excluded: node_modules, .next, package-lock, public/, images/fonts/binary DBs. Chronological by first commit.
Companion TSV: LEAD_SEAT_INVENTORY_20260821.tsv (same rows, machine-readable).

# V24 landing estimator and phased arming

V24 is one replay variant of otherwise unchanged V23. It fits q25/q50/q75 own-close landing deltas on causal walk-forward training rows, excludes the five exact-start games, abstains on the 339 unreso

V23 non-regression: joint >=45 and carried <=88. See FRONTIER.json for the result and MISS_LEDGER_CONSERVATION.json for the 1,608-row address conservation.
```

```
## STANDING RULINGS

- **Pair is the entry unit:** every entry decision governs the two-sided pair; no side is independently optimized. (`e6391a80f1b14a0ee5d073581640dcd2d6000e3a`)
- **Game is the row:** operator-facing grading and accountability conserve one row per game, with both sides inside it. (`59cc32b35337504cd059996d2a12cbc831952595`)
- **The carry has no clock:** an uncompleted side lives or dies by causal book evidence and the guarded Window-1 boundary, never elapsed carry time. (`2d1499a429d9959d62d099fdc88019c6733a94d7`)
```
